hypothesis: The 27-dimensional pitch-family repertoire shape discarded by sparse component C may transfer when compressed into a low-dimensional, immutable pitcher archetype rather than exposed as noisy raw group means.

novelty_audit.raw_rich_profiles: The exact parent retains overall TrackMan moments but deliberately drops all pitch-family rates and physical means.
novelty_audit.stability_and_conditional_profiles: Previously tested as raw engineered coordinates; no PCA or frozen unsupervised archetype was used.
novelty_audit.supervised_factorization: Previously failed matchup factorization used control labels, not target-free repertoire geometry.

data_contract.profile_cutoff: matched R TrackMan seasons strictly before each query row season
data_contract.basis_cutoff: scaler, PCA, and KMeans fit once on official 2019 R TrackMan pitcher profiles and never refit

fixed_archetype_recipe.source_coordinates: three group rates plus sqrt(group_rate) times each group physical mean minus overall pitcher mean for eight TrackMan measurements
fixed_archetype_recipe.missing_group_mean: weighted deviation fixed to zero; the group rate separately records absence
fixed_archetype_recipe.generated_features: 8 PCA coordinates, one categorical cluster, nearest-centroid distance, second-minus-first distance margin, and unseen indicator

execution_order.target_free_first: record representation variance and cross-cutoff stability without reading control_success
execution_order.continue_to_2023_only_if: 2022 R point gain and pitcher-cluster 95% CI lower are positive versus exact C and both honest R anchors
execution_order.read_2024_only_if: the unchanged recipe passes every 2022 and 2023 requirement
